summary: Four demonstrated failures: missing source family, interval-based answer leakage, narrowed blank grading, and broken blank rendering. The exact easy batch survives filtering; tested algebra and packaging pass.

source_analysis.skill: Finding explicit general solutions of first-order separable ODEs by algebraic rearrangement, separation, integration and solving for y.
reasoning_steps: Rearrange/factor the ODE and honor its nonzero and interval restrictions.
Separate x and y and integrate each side.
Solve for y, absorb nonzero scales into arbitrary constants, select branches from the domain.
Select one of five complete expressions, or enter the missing expression in the given explicit solution scaffold.
invariants: First-order separable equations with elementary antiderivatives; no initial-value fitting, integrating factors or nonseparable equations.
Preserve source radio versus blank response contract and complete distractor families at replay.
Preserve nonzero/domain/branch assumptions. Nonzero exponential solutions require nonzero K.
Requested easy difficulty has no captured easy exercise: canonical polynomial example is the nearest conservative difficulty anchor; do not relabel inverse-trigonometric/involved power forms easy.
permitted_variations: Change signed small coefficients, linear/quadratic monomial powers and additive terms while retaining the same integration method and workload.
Change the coefficient sign so the antiderivative/exponent/denominator must change, rather than preserving a sign pattern as an incidental answer cue.
For supported trigonometric families vary supported sine/cosine roles and signs with dependent antiderivatives; for shifted y family vary the shift coherently.
Vary which bank member is correct and its position; do not fix a uniquely recognizable expression shape unless it follows from the intended mathematics.
Vary the missing polynomial term/coefficient in source blank scaffolds; x^2 is an example assignment, not an invariant.
The positive branch in q-79666 follows y>0; changing a valid branch assumption must change the explicit answer.

source_replay.details: 14/15 complete captured exercise families replay, including all 66 bank values and correct designations for supported exercises. q-128198 is absent and rejected.

math.details: 93 option-bank checks use independent printed-TeX reading and differentiation, rejecting singleton particular solutions as general answers. All tested keys pass; 81 keyed solutions also simplify exactly to zero ODE residual on a valid positive local branch. Source domain omissions are recorded separately; no global real-domain completeness claim.

variety.details: Easy signs and coefficients vary, and actual batch 5/5 survives with both exponent signs. The independent y=±sqrt(blank+K) source family is suppressed entirely; old fourteen-source declarations do not cover the current fifteen-source evidence.

scope.details: Normal q-128191 adds a nonconstant-polynomial-only restriction to avoid the source arbitrary-K family-equivalence grading limitation. This narrows the original valid response contract. Other tested variations retain elementary separation/integration workload.

grading.details: 17 ordinary equivalent/correct submissions accepted and 66 wrong submissions rejected by native learning::grade_field. Strict source-family test x^2+5 is wrongly rejected although K absorbs +5. The missing engine capability remains a failing acceptance test.

rendering.details: Actual UI inspection reveals blank scaffold math rendered literally inside Markdown code blocks at a=1 and a=4. Automated renderer passed because MathJax never processed those code blocks; screenshot and HTML override that automated claim.

packaging.details: Exact installed Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 match nested manifest dependencies. Declared files exist; complete package relocation preserves deterministic output. Parameter rejections tested; package hashes unchanged; no DB or publication operations.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant paired updates are coherent, but default interval wording leaks integrated expressions. Copy-and-power rules succeed 4/4 within each of three affected templates and 12/12 after delivery. Exact easy batch has no such leak. All six captured generated inventory entries reproduce; none belongs to the demonstrated defective families.

findings.description: Normal interval restrictions print the integrated answer-bearing expression. In q-79665, choose the square of the printed expression; in q-8304 choose its power 2/3. These actions bypass integration across changed coefficients and survive delivery. q-8303 similarly prints F+C.
